documented_probe: C-8c746cc6 (implement column-parallel 'tensor-parallel' linear layers with full reconstruction and correct sharded gradients): reference floor is hard and this covering task exercises it at hard — sharded forward with all-gather reconstruction, exact per-rank gradient slices, a CLI validation harness, and a non-divisible-dimension failure mode on hidden configs.
